test_cloud_success_no_fallback: test _get_session_info returns cloud session without fallback markers when cloud provider succeeds
test_cloud_and_local_both_fail: test _get_session_info raises RuntimeError with both cloud and local error contexts when both fail
test_cdp_override_bypasses_provider: test _get_session_info uses CDP override URL directly without consulting cloud provider
test_fallback_logs_warning_with_provider: test _get_session_info logs a warning with provider class name and error message on fallback
